title: Propulsion Assignment
description:
The assignment is available online. Submit a link to the landing page of your Web application running on Netlify. The landing page should include the following:
- Your full name and section
- Links to each of the lab assignments
- Link to the Kanbas application
- Links to all relevant source code repositories
The Kanbas application should include a link to navigate back to the landing page

title: Combustion Analysis
description: The assignment is available online. Perform a detailed analysis of the combustion process in a jet engine using provided datasets.

title: Nozzle Design Project
description: The assignment is available online. Design a nozzle using CAD tools and perform simulations to evaluate its efficiency.

title: Aerodynamics Quiz
description: A timed quiz focused on key principles of aerodynamics, including lift and drag equations.

title: Flow Analysis
description: Conduct a computational flow analysis using the given simulation software and submit a report on your findings.

title: Heating Analysis
description: Analyze heat distribution in a high-speed flow scenario and provide optimization suggestions.

title: Structural Design Task
description: Design a lightweight structural component for a spacecraft and evaluate its stress tolerances.

title: Orbital Calculations
description: Calculate orbital parameters for a satellite mission using the provided scenarios.

title: Systems Engineering Exam
description: An open-book exam covering systems engineering concepts, with an emphasis on integration and testing phases.
